query: WITH RECURSIVE subtree AS (SELECT id FROM central.workflow_nodes WHERE id = $1::uuid UNION ALL SELECT n.id FROM central.workflow_nodes n JOIN subtree s ON n.parent_node_id = s.id ) SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM central.artifact_produce_edges pe JOIN central.artifacts a ON a.id = pe.artifact_id WHERE pe.node_id IN (SELECT id FROM subtree) AND a.state = ANY($2::text[]))
